inputs.text: They want you to believe this is just a simple street protest in Abuja on Thursday, but look closer at who is really pulling the strings behind the Joint Health Sector Unions and the Assembly of Healthcare Professional Associations. It is all a carefully staged distraction by the hidden elites pushing these reform bills through the National Assembly. They gathered right at the Unity Fountain in Maitama to put on a show, but this manufactured chaos is designed to push their true, concealed agenda under the radar while the public is distracted by the staged opposition.
